name: sosein
description: Collaborate with Sosein's production artifacts from Codex through the Sosein MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Collaborate on Sosein artifacts from Codex
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to production Sosein through OAuth-backed MCP. Search and read artifacts, create documents, notes, or records privately or in a workspace, work with structured objects, make block-checked edits, and collaborate through reviews, comments, and suggestions using access delegated from the signed-in user.
